security.withheld: Leseva ayiboleki i-token yayo kuticwayiso te-Dependabot, tekuhlola ikhodi netekuhlola timfihlo, ngobe bonkhe labavakashile bebatatibona; sibalo ngasinye sixhumanisa ku-GitHub esikhundleni saloko. Sibonelo lesiyimfihlo singasetha {flag}.
security.refused: "kute kungena" kusho kutsi kute i-token, i-token lete imvume yekufundza lolohlobo lwesicwayiso, noma sici sicishiwe kulesigcinelo.

token.title: 🔑 I-token ye-GitHub
token.intro: GitHub iphendvula ticelo leti-60 ngelihora ekhelini lelingatfumeli i-token. Sihlahla lesiphelele sema-fork sibita cishe ticelo leti-32, ngako kuvakasha kwesibili kuphelelwa. I-token ikhuphula umkhawulo kuya ku-5000 ngelihora.
token.step1: Vula Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, bese u-Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: i-akhawunti yakho. Expiration: noma ngabe ngusiphi lusuku, sihlahla asidzingi lutho lolwehlala sikhatsi lesidze.
token.step4: Ungatsintsi imvume nayinye. I-metadata yetigcinelo temphakatsi ayidzingi nayinye kuto.
token.step5: Yakha, bese ukopisha linani le-{token}. GitHub ilikhombisa kanye kuphela.
token.classic: I-token yakudzala nayo iyasebenta: yakha lengenalo lubanti lolukhetsiwe. Lubanti lolungenalutfo lusafundza idatha yemphakatsi ngelizinga lelicinisekisiwe.
token.stays: Ihlala kulesiphequluli ngaphansi kwesikhiya {key} futsi iya ku-{host} kuphela. Ayibhalwa nanini kubha yelikheli, ngako sichumanisi losabelana ngaso sitfwala umbukiso hhayi imininingwane yekungena. Inkinobho ngaphansi kwenkhundla iyayesula kanye ne-cache.
token.persistHow: Faka i-token efayilini le-{env} leseva lesingatsa leli khasi, eceleni kwa-{port}:
token.proxy: bese uyicalisa nga-{make}. Sitsatsi-mphahla sibese sibhala sicephu se-nginx lesengeta sihloko se-{header} ku-proxy ye-{path}, ngako siphequluli sibita umsuka waso futsi asiyitfoli nanini i-token. Lenkhundla iyanyamalala futsi tonkhe tivakashi tabelana ngesabelo sinye se-5000 ngelihora.
fork.refused404: Kute imigca yemagatja: {message}. I-404 lapha kungaba ligatja lelingekho noma indlela lengatfwalwa yi-proxy yeseva; lunetha lwema-fork lolungenhla luphelele noma kunjani.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub iphelelwe ticelo kulelihora, ngako kute imigca yemagatja lekhone kudvwetjwa. Lunetha lwema-fork lolungenhla luphelele. Engeta i-token kuphaneli yesihlungi, noma ucime imigca yemagatja kuphaneli yekubukeka kute usebentise sabelo kulunetha kuphela.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub iphendvule nge-{status} emlandvweni wema-commit, ngako kute imigca yemagatja lekhone kudvwetjwa. Lunetha lwema-fork lolungenhla luphelele.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Lithegi alinalo lusuku, ngako lasele ngalinye belitawubita sicelo lesabelo lesisele selihora singasetjentiswa kuso.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, lifasitela lema-commit nemathegi lalayishiwe. Imigca yema-fork lemidzala kunalo iyacindzetelwa emaphetfweni langesencele.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Vula sigcinelo kute udvwebe imizila yaso yema-commit nekuhlanganiswa; i-eksisi ibese iyancipha kuya kulowo mlandvo.

forks.deeper.other: La-{n} kuwo aphindze enta ema-fork; vula linye kute uye ekujuleni.

forks.leaves: kute nalinye kuwo leliphindze lenta ema-fork, ngako lolu lunetha lonkhe.
forks.lazy: Chofoza sigcinelo kute ubukise emagatja aso ngentasi kwaso emugceni wesikhatsi lofanako.
forks.exhausted: GitHub iphelelwe ticelo kulelihora. Engeta i-token kuphaneli yesihlungi kute ukhuphule umkhawulo kusuka ku-60 kuya ku-5000, noma ubuye nangabe lihora selishintjile.

bond.title: Imethrikisi yekuhlangana
bond.help: Umugca uye kukholamu ngenhla, likholamu liye emugceni ngentasi. Kuhlangana kwa-0 likhasi, 1 kuphambene nalo. Kuhamba ngaphetulu kukhombisa lokubili ngesiphuzi, kuchofoza kukubamba ngelubala lolu-phephuli kuze kube kuchofoza lokulandzelako. Kufundza kuphela; sebentisa i-CLI infinito bond kute uhlele.

tests.status.skipped: lisango lekweca licishiwe lapha; livivinyo liyasebenta kolunye luhlobo
tests.status.always: kute luhlobo loluncuma lelisango, ngako livivinyo aliciniseki nanini
tests.status.unknown: lolu luhlobo lishiya lisango livulekile; lolunye luyalincuma
tests.note.noSort: Ayikho i-INFINITO_DISCOVERY_SORT: faka i-default.env ye-checkout ye-core (INFINITO_ENV_FILE) kute uhlele ngeludvwendvwe lwekufaka.
